info.longName: Genter Capital Taxable Quality Intermediate ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal market conditions, the Advisor intends to invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in investment grade, intermediate term securities. The securities in which the fund invests will typically be investment grade (rated BBB or better by either Moody’s Investors Services, Inc. (“Moody’s”) or Standard & Poor’s (“S&P”) and unrated securities considered by the Subadvisor to be of comparable credit quality).
